summary: Phase 7 (filter/search roadmaps by tag & level) verified end-to-end. 13/13 new backend pytest cases pass, 17/17 prior regression pytest cases (cookie+CSRF+resources CRUD) still green, and 9/9 frontend Playwright steps pass across /roadmaps filtering and /admin/roadmaps autosave + create-with-tags flows. Feature is production-ready.

key_assertions_covered: GET /api/roadmaps populates tags + level per roadmap (frontend/backend/devops/+user-created)
GET /api/tags returns sorted unique tags (react, python, kubernetes among them)
POST /api/roadmaps (editor + CSRF) with tags='  Foo, bar, foo ', level='beginner' -> persisted tags='foo,bar', level='beginner'
PUT /api/roadmaps/{id} with tags='NEW, tag, new', level='intermediate' -> persisted 'new,tag' and reflected in subsequent GET /api/roadmaps
Detail endpoint GET /api/roadmaps/frontend exposes tags + level
Existing flows still pass: progress upsert (cookie+CSRF), /api/admin/users (cookie admin)

passed_steps: /roadmaps shows 4 cards with new filter UI (search input, level select, tag chip bag, no Clear visible initially)
Each card shows level badge (e.g., MIXED on frontend, ADVANCED on devops) and up to 4 tag chips
Deselect react then level=advanced -> filters to ['devops']
Searching 'zzzzz-no-such' shows roadmaps-empty element with 'Clear filters' link
/admin/roadmaps (editor): admin-tags-input-frontend + admin-level-select-frontend rendered; editing tags triggers debounced auto-save (500ms) -> persisted on next GET /api/roadmaps

Create new roadmap via dialog: filled slug/title/level=advanced/status=published/tags='PlayWright, Kubernetes, playwright' -> persisted; tag chip #kubernetes filter returns new roadmap together with devops; level badge shows ADVANCED; tag list rendered

issues: Console warning: pattern attribute /^[a-z0-9-]+$/v: 'Invalid character class' in Chromium UnicodeSets mode. Cosmetic — form still submits and slug is also validated server-side via Pydantic pattern. Suggest changing the JSX pattern to '^[a-z0-9\\-]+$' or '^[-a-z0-9]+$' (dash at start) to suppress the warning.

action_items: Optional: escape dash in AdminRoadmaps.jsx new-roadmap-slug pattern to clear the Chrome /v console warning (cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: Tag matching SQL in list_roadmaps uses a 4-clause OR (equality + 3 LIKE patterns) — correct and boundary-safe; verified against tag='reac' not matching 'react'. Consider extracting into a helper if reused.
_normalize_tags correctly lowercases, trims, dedupes (insertion order preserved). Behaviour matches PRD ('Foo, bar, foo' -> 'foo,bar') ✓.
RoadmapDetail also surfaces tags+level (good — useful for the detail page even if filter UI lives on the list).
server.py is now ~680 lines; recommend splitting into routers (auth/roadmaps/resources/progress/admin) for maintainability — same comment as iteration 4.
Frontend RoadmapList.jsx debounces the filtered fetch by 200ms which feels snappy; URLSearchParams handling is correct (omits 'all' for level — matches backend sentinel handling).

MetaEditor in AdminRoadmaps.jsx auto-saves on every keystroke after 500ms — for very long tag strings users may experience multiple POSTs as they type; current implementation cancels previous timer via cleanup so only the final keystroke fires, which is correct.
Console warning on regex pattern in /v mode (see design_issues). Minor.
seed_data_creation: Each backend test creates+deletes its own TEST_ prefixed roadmap. Frontend test created 'test-ui-{rand}' and cleaned it up via admin DELETE (status 204). DB is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 7 filter/search end-to-end verified. Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_cookie_csrf_resources.py (17 tests) + new /app/backend/tests/test_filter_search.py (13 tests) cover auth, CSRF, resources, progress, admin, plus the new tags/level/q/tag filters + /api/tags + tag normalization. Future iterations should keep running both pytest files (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var required). Note: an old 'Ma roadmap démo' user-created roadmap (slug starts with 'ma-' or similar) remains from earlier iterations and is published with 9 blocks.
